meta.name: decision-toolkit
meta.description: Generate structured decision-making tools — step-by-step guides, bias checkers, scenario explorers, and interactive dashboards. Use when facing significant choices requiring systematic analysis. Supports multiple cognitive styles and output formats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作决策指南和仪表盘，系统分析复杂选择
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需系统性地分析复杂决策
copy.tagline_en: Create decision guides and dashboards to systematically analyze complex choices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to systematically analyze complex decisions

howto.what: Claude 会帮你生成结构化的决策工具，如分步指南、偏见检查表、情景分析器和交互式仪表盘，引导你系统地分析重要选择。
howto.when: 当你面临需要系统分析的重大选择时触发，例如职业变动、投资评估、项目优先排序或合作决策。

say.text: 帮我分析这个会议记录，生成决策工具。
say.note: Claude 提取信息并生成交互式 HTML 指南。

say.text: 我该不该接受这份新工作？帮我做个决策分析。
say.note: Claude 定制职业决策框架并输出。

say.text: 帮我评估这个合作机会，用框架分析。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you generate structured decision-making tools such as step-by-step guides, bias checklists, scenario explorers, and interactive dashboards to systematically analyze significant choices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you face a major decision requiring systematic analysis, e.g., career change, investment evaluation, project prioritization, or partnership decisions.

say_en.text: Analyze this meeting transcript and create a decision toolkit.
say_en.note: Generates an interactive HTML guide from the transcript.

say_en.text: Should I take this new job? Walk me through a decision analysis.
say_en.note: Customizes a framework for career decisions.

say_en.text: Help me think through this partnership decision, just give me the frameworks.
say_en.note: Outputs a Markdown framework without interactive tool.
